summary: Frontend-only verification of thumbnail rewrite, lazy/async decoding, aspect-ratio containers, module cache for /api/gallery, and broken-image resilience. Most fixes verified working; two issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — JSX must use camelCase fetchPriority attribute (also invalid to pass to in React without camelCase). Console pollution on every page.

integration_issues.issue: HomeGallery.jsx calls api.get('/gallery') directly (line 50) instead of using the new useGallery() module cache. As a result, opening '/' fires a fresh /api/gallery request (observed 2 calls on home navigation) that bypasses the 45s cache. Refactor HomeGallery to use useGallery() so all three public pages share the cache.

verification_details.drive_thumb_rewrite_verified: Confirmed: e.g. https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/18k5sSbJaE2ny0BW6JXCUEUwi0oq5sF6A=w600 (folder card 4 on Residential tab)

action_items: Refactor /app/frontend/src/components/HomeGallery.jsx to consume useGallery() from /app/frontend/src/lib/useGallery.js instead of calling api.get('/gallery') directly. This unifies the module cache across / , /works and /gallery.
Fix React JSX camelCase attribute in /app/frontend/src/components/SmartImage.jsx line 47: change `fetchpriority={...}` to `fetchPriority={...}` to eliminate the DOM property warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SmartImage.jsx uses `fetchpriority` (lowercase) which React rejects — must be `fetchPriority`.
HomeGallery.jsx duplicates gallery-fetch logic and bypasses the newly-added cache layer; single-source-of-truth via useGallery() is safer and matches WorksPage/GalleryPage.
test_credentials: Not needed for this run (public pages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All performance-oriented DOM-level checks pass on /works and /gallery — SmartImage renders with loading=lazy, decoding=async, aspect-ratio 4/5, and Drive URLs are rewritten to =w600 for cards. Module cache proven: 0 /api/gallery refetches during 4 tab flips and 3 folder drill-downs. Two remaining fixes: (a) HomeGallery must use useGallery(); (b) SmartImage attribute name typo (fetchpriority -> fetchPriority). After these, re-verify that home '/' navigation issues at most 1 /api/gallery call within 45s of a prior /works or /gallery visit.
